parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: The peak bandwidth of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid value: **10**.

parameters.name: GlobalAccelerationInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. 

You can invoke the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.
